paired_holdout.reading: The brief-compliant configuration (224 m catalogue exclusion + hard Stage-1 q10 allowed domain) reproduces the archived arm's fold values exactly under the baseline rule and costs 0.001547 mean proxy DTI (0.55% relative). This is a compliance cost, not a claimed improvement; the candidate is NOT promoted as a score gain.

independent_provenance_evidence.instrument: off-catalogue A/B split of the known catalogue (seed 51): the model is fitted on split A only and scored against split B fault systems that are at least 5 px from every A pixel

recommended_upload_candidate.encoding_note: All pixels are finite and in [0, 1]; 0.0 is written outside the survey footprint (nan_cells = 0, values_outside_0_1 = 0). The official format text asks for null/nan outside the data bounds, so both encodings are locally defensible; the all-finite encoding additionally cannot fail a naive `0 <= v <= 1` portal check, which is the class of error the user reported. No truth pixels exist outside the footprint, so the outside-footprint value cannot change the score.
limitations: Local gates only: no DrivenData score, upload or acceptance is claimed.
The hidden-truth mass 12700 is an estimate inferred from reported sibling scores; the mass sensitivity table lists the alternatives that were considered.
Stage 1 is a coarse allowed domain; it is weak on the proxy instrument and never weights an individual emitted point.
Not portal-validated: no upload has been performed from this repository and no organizer response is recorded.
Not organizer-scored: every number quoted is a local proxy on the visible known-fault catalogue.
The paired six-fold screen costs mean proxy DTI -0.001547 versus the archived H-D configuration; the artifact is presented as constraint-compliant, not as a score improvement.
